data.text:
If you're looking to head outside India anytime soon, these are some countries that have made international travel increasingly accessible for us (Indians), whether through visa-free entry, e-visa options, or streamlined visa-on-arrival processes.

Here's a breakdown of some top destinations with improved access:

Recently Enhanced Access / New Options:

- Palau: Offers 30-day visa-free entry, a recent exciting addition for a tropical escape.
- Philippines: Provides 14 to 30-day visa-free tiers, depending on whether you hold specific valid visas from other major countries.
- Israel: Has introduced a new e-Visa system (eVisa-B2) for Indian citizens, simplifying the application process significantly.
- Russia: While individual travel still requires an e-visa, Russia is actively working towards a 30-day visa-free regime for organized tourist groups, expected in Spring 2025.
- Japan: Introduced an e-Visa system for Indian citizens starting April 2024 for short-term tourism stays.
- Thailand: The 60-day visa exemption for Indian nationals has been extended indefinitely. However, be aware that from May 2025, financial proof and completing the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) may be required.
- Malaysia: Continues to offer 30-day visa-free entry until December 31, 2026. Remember to complete your Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) before arrival.
- Sri Lanka: Has reintroduced its online Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) system, allowing for visa-free entry for up to 30 days (valid until at least March 31, 2025).
Iran: Offers 15-day visa-free entry for Indian tourists arriving by air.
- Dubai (UAE): Offers a five-year multiple-entry tourist visa for Indian nationals, allowing stays of up to 90 days per visit.
- South Africa: Is introducing a Digital Entry Travel Agreement (ETA) system to simplify entry for foreign visitors, including Indians.

Long-Standing Visa-Free / Visa-on-Arrival Favorites:

- Mauritius: Enjoy 90-day visa-free travel.
- Nepal: Unlimited visa-free travel.
- Bhutan: Unlimited visa-free travel, but note the Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) applies for tourists.
- Fiji: Offers 120-day visa-free entry.
- Indonesia: Provides straightforward e-Visa or Visa-on-Arrival options for up to 30 days.
- Jamaica: Offers 90-day visa-free entry.
- Qatar: Provides 30-day visa-free entry.
- Laos, Cambodia, Maldives, Jordan, Ethiopia, Kenya, Mozambique, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tanzania, Vietnam: Many of these offer visa-on-arrival or e-visa options.

(Visa policies can change frequently. Always, always verify the most current and specific entry requirements directly with the official embassy, consulate, or immigration website of your destination country before making any travel plans.)
